recommendations.recommendation: Rule yourself through self-control and self-reliance rather than depending on outside institutions.
recommendations.rationale: True freedom comes from mastery of one's own desires, not from external power.
recommendations.argued_against: Dependence on modern institutions and on the pursuit of material comfort.

recommendations.recommendation: Reject the material aims of modern Western civilization and live with simplicity.
recommendations.rationale: Modern civilization weakens moral character by multiplying wants.
recommendations.argued_against: Reliance on railways, lawyers, doctors, and machinery, and the pursuit of wealth and luxury.

recommendations.recommendation: Resist injustice through nonviolent moral force rather than physical force.
recommendations.rationale: Moral force, based on truth and suffering willingly borne, is stronger than brute force.
recommendations.argued_against: Reliance on violence and force to resist wrong.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid violence and hatred, even when wronged.
recommendations.rationale: Violence is contrary to the moral law and cannot produce lasting good.

recommendations.recommendation: Cultivate truth and self-respect in your conduct.
recommendations.rationale: Truth and self-respect are the basis of a moral life.

recommendations.recommendation: Serve your community and draw on the moral wisdom of Indian tradition.
recommendations.rationale: Ancient moral teaching offers a sounder guide than imported modern values.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
